description: Crawli is sourcing intelligence for secondhand fashion resellers. It queries 9 resale marketplaces simultaneously and returns ranked, comparable listings in one unified view, then shows sold-price comps and net flip margin after real platform fees.
capabilities: Sold-price comps: median, 25th-75th percentile, sample size, and days to sell (Grailed and Poshmark) — Pro only
Resale margin calculator with platform-specific seller fee deductions, seeded from real sold prices — Pro only
Daily and weekly price alerts for saved searches
Save and organise listings into folders
Brand alias matching (e.g. BAPE = A Bathing Ape, CDG = Comme des Garçons)
Prepaid credit packs for extra searches on the Free plan

public_pages.description: Public no-login price comparison pages for popular resale items. Updated daily.

price_intelligence_note: Sold-price comps, the price summary, and the flip-margin calculator are Pro-only. Free accounts see live listings across all 9 marketplaces but not the computed price intelligence.
